observation: Fresh-main inspection found mission creation intended maxCycles/maxRepairs/closureThreshold to be bounded, but Number(nonNumeric) propagated NaN through Math.min/Math.max and JSON serialization could persist null. Durable reads only checked that config keys existed, so externally rewritten out-of-range or wrong-type config values could alter repair budgets, closure decisions, cycle budgets, or auto-commit behavior.
changes: Normalize non-finite mission config inputs to existing defaults before bounding them.
Fail closed when durable mission config values are non-finite, out of the existing creation bounds, or autoCommit is non-boolean.
Publish those already-existing runtime bounds and boolean policy in Autonomous Mission v0.1 and bind them with a focused contract regression.

verification.pre_fix_source_contract_replay: EXPECTED FAIL: Number('not-a-number') produced NaN in creation, JSON could persist null, and validMissionShape only required config key presence.
verification.post_fix_source_contract_replay: PASS: creation has finite fallbacks; durable read/update validation enforces the same 1..64, 0..8, 0.5..1 bounds and boolean autoCommit shape; schema publishes the same contract.
verification.focused_regression_contract: Checked-in mission contract test asserts config field bounds and runtime helper presence.
verification.hosted_runtime: Developer Execution Runtime remained unavailable with HTTP 502; no hosted full-suite pass is claimed.

truth_boundary: This cycle preserves the bounds and autoCommit semantics already present in mission creation. It does not choose a new scheduler policy, cycle budget, repair policy, or delivery architecture.
